messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Pantoprazole is a proton pump inhibitor that decreases the amount of acid produced in the stomach.
Pantoprazole is used to treat erosive esophagitis.
Erosive esophagitis is damage to the esophagus from stomach acid.
This damage is caused by gastroesophageal reflux disease, or GERD.
Pantoprazole is used in adults and children who are at least 5 years old.
Pantoprazole is usually given for up to 8 weeks at a time while your esophagus heals.
Pantoprazole is also used to treat Zollinger-Ellison syndrome and other conditions involving excess stomach acid.

Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'belongs to drug class': The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological or therapeutic drug class specified by the object entity.
B. 'has status': The subject drug has a specific status or classification specified by the object entity.
C. 'means drug used in way': The subject term describes the usage of a drug in a manner that is specified by the object entity.
